name: prd-ownership-deny-codex
doc: Same claim contract as 30-prd-ownership-deny-claude, spawned as `hook codex core` — proves the guard is harness-shared, not claude-only. Step 1: backend-expert claims its own slot via an apply_patch Add File (allowed, binds); step 2: the same agent_id patches backend-expert-2's report -> deny (one slot per agent). Codex's deny envelope is the same denyResponse() shape as Claude (hookSpecificOutput.permissionDecision).
